thread:
Omar (AE): Heads-up — we're planning to flip the ratecard schema to v2 next Thursday. Major practical changes: SKU codes are being normalized, and the commit column name changes from `commit_tier` -> `commit_level`. This will affect quoting and existing commits. Who needs to weigh in on migration rules? :eyes:

Mira (Deal Desk): Thanks Omar. Need clarity on two buckets: 1) active committed deals (signed or PO in flight) and 2) pending quotes/POCs. For active deals we should not change pricing mid-term — will need mapping + amendment language. For pending quotes, prefer to require new SKU in new quotes.

Alyssa (Sales Ops): Quick mapping I put together (draft):
```
legacy_sku,legacy_commit_tier -> new_sku,new_commit_level
RC-STD-100,bronze -> RC-V2-STD,level-1
RC-STD-250,silver -> RC-V2-STD,level-2
RC-BIZ-500,gold -> RC-V2-BIZ,level-3
```
This maps existing commit buckets to the new normalized codes. I can export full mapping as CSV.

Kevin (Legal): Important: any automated migration email to customers must explicitly say this is a nomenclature/schema update and not a price increase. For active contracts we need an amendment template that mirrors existing economic terms (no uplift) and records the new SKU for systems. I'll draft an addendum and share.

Raj (Finance): We need the mapping to include GL code and revenue recognition bucket. If a SKU name changes but price stays same, our billing system still needs the old->new GL linkage. Effective date? We prefer first of next month for clean cut.

Mira (Deal Desk): Proposed phased plan:
- Phase 1 (Next Thu): Schema v2 accepted by systems, only new quotes use v2 SKUs. No customer-facing change yet.
- Phase 2 (2 weeks later): Offer opt-in migration for customers via amendment + no price change. Sales to coordinate POCs.
- Phase 3 (30 days after opt-in window): Auto-mapping in internal systems for operational continuity, email notice sent to customers 14 days prior.

Omar (AE): For customers mid-POC with trial discounts: do we change the SKU on the trial invoice? Concerned about tracking discounts and ARR.

Alyssa (Sales Ops): For POCs/trials: keep the legacy SKU on customer-facing docs for the duration of the discount/poc. Internally map to new SKU so metrics still roll up. If discount > 25% we require deal desk sign-off (same as current process).

Mira (Deal Desk): I'll add a column to the mapping CSV: `requires_dealdesk_review` boolean. Anything flagged true we require a quick approval thread before migration.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: ratecard-schema/v2 -> staging at 2026-04-02T10:00Z (dry-run).

Kevin (Legal): Also flag customers with contractual price protection clauses — we must not modify price identifiers in a way that could be interpreted as re-pricing. I'll work off a customer list export.

Raj (Finance): Can Sales Ops add the GL mapping and effective date column to the CSV? Finance will validate and sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

Alyssa (Sales Ops): Will do. I'll upload draft CSV here: https://internal.redwood/gists/ratecard-v2-mapping-1804509123.csv and notify billing. Also adding a short checklist for ops:
- confirm GL mapping
- QA billing import on test invoices
- draft customer email template (ops + legal)

Omar (AE): Who owns communication to customers in opt-in window? I can handle accounts I'm AE on, but need a template.

Mira (Deal Desk): Sales owns outreach for active opportunities. I'll create a canned message and track opt-ins in the deal desk tracker.

Kevin (Legal): Draft amendment uploaded: https://internal.redwood/docs/ratecard-v2-amendment-draft (comments welcome).

Raj (Finance): Finance sign-off blocked until GL mapping is present. Once Alyssa uploads CSV I'll do a pass.

Alyssa (Sales Ops): Action items: 1) finalize CSV + GL mapping (me) by EOD tomorrow 2) draft customer email template (me + legal) 3) deploy dry-run to staging tomorrow morning (eng) 4) deal desk to review flagged rows (Mira).

Mira (Deal Desk): I'll run a query to list active deals created before cutoff and flag anything with special commercial terms.

Omar (AE): Thanks — ping me once the template exists and I’ll cascade to my AE team. :thumbsup:

Alyssa (Sales Ops): Will ping #sales-announce once we have the final CSV + FAQ. Expected timeline: schema v2 rollout begins next Thu; internal auto-mapping rollout ~4 weeks.

(ends)
notes: internal-only thread about ratecard schema migration; contains links to internal artifacts; no customer PII.
